references.text: Aaron and the priests were tasked with distinguishing between holy and common, between unclean and clean, and to teach the Israelites all the laws the Lord had given them through Moses.
The conclusion of the laws concerning clean and unclean animals, which also deals with distinguishing between unclean and clean.
The beginning of the laws regarding leprosy (tsara'at), which Leviticus 14:57 summarizes and concludes.
The beginning of the law for cleansing from leprosy, which verse 57 ends with the words 'this is the law concerning leprosy'.
The preceding verses that list the various forms of leprosy covered by this law.
Moses reminds the people to carefully follow what the Levitical priesthood teaches about leprosy.
Ezekiel prophesies that the priests shall teach the people the difference between holy and common, and between unclean and clean.
The prophet Malachi emphasizes that the lips of the priest should preserve knowledge, and that the people should seek guidance from his mouth.
